purpose: Why can total entropy rise while energy stays balanced?
meaning: Subtract and add the same transferred energy divided by heat capacity, then add the logarithmic entropy changes.

definition.setting: Two small insulated teaching bodies start at 400 K and 300 K. Each needs one joule per kelvin of temperature change. Transfer energy from the hot body to the cold one, stopping when both reach 350 K. Follow the two temperature changes and their separate entropy changes.

conditions: Two insulated bodies each have constant heat capacity 1 J/K. Heat moves from 400 K toward 300 K until both reach 350 K. No work, phase change or environmental exchange is modeled. Entropy is in J/K, not bits.
